clue.text: Tea brought round at one was condemned by the orthodox

indicators.note: the tea word is brought round the next piece, so it wraps around it as a container

parts.note: char is informal British slang for tea

explanation.definitionFit: The Cathars were a medieval Christian sect denounced as heretics by the Catholic Church.

clue.text: As recipients of letter, great people only half reply

explanation.definitionFit: Paul's epistle was addressed to the church at Colossae, so its recipients were the Colossians.

clue.text: Garment, despite being shortened, no good

clue.text: Aversion to king being erected in marble

clue.text: Front part of train, and who's in it

explanation.definitionFit: The vanguard is the foremost part of an advancing army, hence the front.

clue.text: A ray angled across the plane

clue.text: What may be sneezed into the air — and then some land

parts.words: What may be sneezed into the air

clue.text: A second spire is silly, on reflection

clue.text: I add flavour that's finally needed badly

explanation.definitionFit: Dill is a herb used for seasoning, so it is something that flavours food.

clue.text: Against abortion, shortly in charge of having many children

clue.text: Approach, ladies, and spread round back of hall

clue.text: Dance round piano and push off

clue.text: Start naming defence for game
